title: Correction Entries Against a Charge Standing on an Auto Loan
content:
Where a late charge standing on a loan of the Auto Loans line is above the amount this charter fixes for it, it is put right by one correction entry booked against that charge. The loan's unpaid charges fall by the amount of that entry, and the remainder of the charge stands.

## The capability

The servicing desk's tool `correct_loan_fee_ab5fa380` corrects one charge standing on an auto loan by booking a correction entry against it. The entry is recorded as a bank-error adjustment, so the loan's unpaid-fee balance falls by the amount passed in and the corrected charge is left standing at the remainder. The borrower sees the correction on the loan's activity as a fee adjustment dated today, and the loan's unpaid fees figure drops immediately.

## How it is invoked

The tool is hidden. The agent unlocks `correct_loan_fee_ab5fa380` and then calls it; the agent performs this correction themselves rather than handing it to the borrower.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `auto_loan_id` | The reference number of the auto loan whose charge is being corrected, read from the loan record returned by the auto loan lookup before the call | Id |
| `customer_id` | The reference number identifying the borrower who holds that loan, read from the customer profile lookup before the call | Id |
| `source_item_id` | The reference number of the single ledger entry that carries the charge being corrected, read from the loan activity lookup before the call | Id |
| `fee_code` | Which kind of charge the corrected entry carries, exactly as the loan activity shows it | Enum |
| `correction_amount` | The amount taken off the charge by this correction | USD with 2 decimal places, always positive, never more than the amount standing for that charge, passed already rounded to the cent |

The complete set of values `fee_code` takes: `none`, where the entry being corrected carries no fee kind at all, which is the case only for an entry that is not one of the loan fee kinds; `late_charge`, where the charge was assessed against an installment that stayed unsatisfied past its grace days; `extension`, where the charge was assessed because installments were deferred to the end of the loan; `returned_payment`, where the charge was assessed because a payment was returned unpaid by the paying bank; and `settlement_reversal`, where the charge is one that became due again when the payment that had paid it was returned.

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new correction entry's reference number, the loan reference number, the amount taken off in USD to the cent, and the loan's unpaid fee balance after the correction. Receiving that sentence means the correction entry exists on the loan's activity and the unpaid fee balance has been reduced.
